dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Hey, it's the Golden Nara, wandering in Vana. Do you have Viparyas, Golden Nara? Can you spare <color=#00E1FFFF>two Viparyas</color> for an Aranara?

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Two Viparyas</color> can keep each other company, telling stories about Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Golden Nara likes to share. Also a friend of Aranara and Vana!

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Good Nara, you're welcome in Vanarana. Aranara will wait for you there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Is that one of the little fairies from before?
